description: This file implements query expansion for full-text search (FTS) mode, including keyword extraction, stop word filtering across multiple languages, tokenization handling for various scripts (English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese), and optional LLM-based query expansion fallback.

methods.name: isQueryStopWordToken
methods.description: Checks if a token is a stop word in multiple languages.

methods.name: extractKeywords
methods.description: Extracts meaningful keywords from a query, filtering out stop words and invalid tokens.

methods.name: expandQueryForFts
methods.description: Expands a user query for FTS by including original and keyword-based OR conditions.

methods.name: expandQueryWithLlm
methods.description: Optionally uses an LLM to expand the query with semantic keywords, falling back to local extraction if needed.
